issues.title: Verify Docker installation and restore on a clean host
issues.body:
## Problem

The image configuration has not been run in the initial build environment. Verify the actual Compose workflow before public release.

## Acceptance criteria

- Record OS/engine versions.
- complete setup/login/CRUD in Docker.
- back up and restore into a new volume.
- test non-root/read-only runtime.
- document defects without private data.

Prepared starter task; this is not evidence of existing users or completed community work.

issues.title: Review Arabic football terminology and mixed-direction fields
issues.body:
## Problem

The initial Arabic dictionary needs review by a football professional and native reader.

## Acceptance criteria

- Review labels in i18n.ts.
- propose specific corrected wording.
- keep key parity.
- test a Latin player name, Arabic notes and ISO dates at mobile width.

Prepared starter task; this is not evidence of existing users or completed community work.

issues.title: Translate schema validation diagnostics into French and Arabic
issues.body:
## Problem

Error headings are translated but detailed schema messages remain technical English.

## Acceptance criteria

- Map stable error codes rather than parsing English text.
- show field-specific corrections in all locales.
- test nested cap-field paths and unknown codes.

issues.title: Verify and improve keyboard focus for record and import dialogs

Native dialogs are used but assistive-technology behavior needs independent verification.

## Acceptance criteria

issues.title: Add boundary fixtures for an additional hypothetical rule combination
issues.body:
## Problem

Rule packs must remain explainable when age and cap windows interact.

## Acceptance criteria

- Use clearly fictional values and example.test sources.
- test exact birthdays and window endpoints.
- test UNVERIFIED/VERIFIED/HISTORICAL behavior.
- do not claim a real regulation.

Prepared starter task; this is not evidence of existing users or completed community work.

issues.title: Design a community rule-pack provenance and review record
issues.body:
## Problem

An owner-controlled VERIFIED field is not independent verification.

## Acceptance criteria

- Propose reviewer/source section/correction history fields.
- document re-verification triggers and disagreements.
- include schema migration and tests before implementation.

issues.title: Add paginated collections and complete streaming exports
issues.body:
## Problem

Lists and matching load full active collections; no scale guarantee is currently made.

## Acceptance criteria

- Measure a disclosed fictional dataset.
- design stable cursors and filtered counts.
- ensure exports remain complete.

issues.title: Add owner-controlled archive restore and retention workflow
issues.body:
## Problem

Archive hides records but there is no UI restore or erasure procedure.

## Acceptance criteria

- Separate restore from irreversible deletion.
- validate dependent references.
- audit actions without retaining erased content.
- document backup implications and test both roles and conflicts.

Prepared starter task; this is not evidence of existing users or completed community work.

issues.title: Design secure owner recovery and optional MFA
issues.body:
## Problem

The MVP has no automated password recovery or second factor.

## Acceptance criteria

- Threat-model hostile setup/recovery requests and stolen backups.
- choose a locally controlled recovery mechanism.
- revoke sessions after recovery.
- add abuse tests and operator guidance.

Prepared starter task; this is not evidence of existing users or completed community work.

issues.title: Define repository contracts and a PostgreSQL adapter
issues.body:
## Problem

Some deployments will need concurrent replicas rather than one SQLite process.

## Acceptance criteria

- Introduce an async port without breaking domain schemas.
- pass identical transaction/conflict/reference tests.
- document migration preserving IDs and restoration before release.

Prepared starter task; this is not evidence of existing users or completed community work.

issues.title: Design scoped integration tokens and a versioned API
issues.body:
## Problem

The internal session API is not a stable external integration contract.

## Acceptance criteria

- Document scopes, revocation, rate limits and versioning.
- prohibit cross-organization access.
- add tests for unauthorized and expired tokens.
- provide a fictional client example.

Prepared starter task; this is not evidence of existing users or completed community work.

issues.title: Run a documented consent-based pilot with football professionals
issues.body:
## Problem

Real-world usefulness needs actual workflow feedback, not invented adoption metrics.

## Acceptance criteria

- Recruit willing testers without posting messages automatically.
- measure setup and task completion with consent.
- record anonymized findings, defects and withdrawals.
- claim only observed participation.

Prepared starter task; this is not evidence of existing users or completed community work.

issues.title: Retire the temporary ESLint compatibility adapter
issues.body:
## Problem

Next bundles plugins with older ESLint peer ranges; a narrow accessor adapter and legacy-peer-deps setting keep current lint checks working.

## Acceptance criteria

- Verify upstream ESLint 10 support.
- remove adapter and peer setting together.
- run clean install, full lint and CI.
- report exact versions, keeping all rules enabled.

Prepared starter task; this is not evidence of existing users or completed community work.
